query: I have a 69-year-old woman. Among female patients age 64–74 hospitalized for AMI, what percentage had index high-sensitivity troponin T categorized as Normal (≤0.014), Borderline (0.015–0.052), or Myocardial Injury (>0.052)?
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(p.dob)) BETWEEN 64 AND 74 AND l.value <= 0.014 THEN l.subject_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.subject_id), 0) AS proportion FROM labevents l JOIN patients p ON l.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN admissions a ON l.subject_id = a.subject_id WHERE l.labtest = 'Troponin T' AND l.itemid = 757071 AND a.admission_type_id = 17;
